title: Steer, Don't Tell: Breaking Reasoning Plateaus with Reachability-Aligned Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.00796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post training for large reasoning models remains insufficient on challenging problems, whose correct trajectories are hard to sample. Though prior works address this difficulty by integrating supervised fine tuning on expert trajectories with reinforcement learning, such external experts are not always available. Existing self improvement methods instead use reference solutions to create a privileged self-teacher. Yet privileged teacher correctness does not imply student reachability. Solution conditioning shifts the teacher distribution toward actions unlikely under the unprivileged student, producing seemingly "correct" trajectories that are unreachable or even mal-formed learning targets. Accordingly, we identify reachability alignment as the key to self constructed supervision and propose Self-Steered Reasoner (SSR). translated_title: 引导而非告知：利用可达性对齐的自蒸馏突破推理瓶颈
translated_abstract: 针对大型推理模型的后训练在具有挑战性的问题上仍然效果不足，因为这些问题难以采样到正确的解题轨迹。尽管先前的工作通过将专家轨迹的监督微调与强化学习相结合来解决这一难题，但外部专家并不总是可得。现有的自我改进方法转而利用参考解来构建一个“特权自我教师”。然而，特权教师答案的正确性并不代表学生模型的可达到性。以参考解为条件的训练会使教师分布偏向于在无特权学生模型下不太可能出现的动作，从而产生看似“正确”但实际不可达、甚至是畸形学习目标的轨迹。因此，我们将可达性对齐确定为自构建监督的关键，并提出了自引导推理器。SSR通过学生支持投影来实现这一原则，即对特权教师分布进行转换……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出自引导推理器（SSR），发现自我蒸馏中“教师答案正确”不等于“学生可达到”的问题，并通过学生支持投影将特权教师分布对齐到学生模型可达范围，从而在无需外部专家的情况下突破大推理模型在难题上的推理平台期。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Self-Steered Reasoner (SSR), which identifies that privileged teacher correctness does not imply student reachability in self-improvement, and uses student support projection to align the teacher distribution with what the student can actually reach, breaking reasoning plateaus without relying on external experts.
